decision: Publish the requested lossless interactive retrospective dataset as one scoped evidence import. The initial representation was 3+ GiB; exact cross-arm demand sharing reduces the browser representation to 1,345,684,306 UTF-8 bytes and 234,917,908 complete gzip bytes. Layer/run chunking follows the requested drill-down model, not a split of oversized original files. All 6,015 whole source copies passed pack-text with zero omissions. Ordinary authored content retains its 20 MiB aggregate guard; every gzip retains the strict 10 MiB per-file ceiling and credential/UTF-8/CRC checks.
scope: This review's completed browser, pinned Plotly distribution, and completed analysis text only. No weights, binary journals/tapes, downloaded source trees, environments, or private configuration.
authority: The Atlas request explicitly requires durable generated browser data and repository gzip publication; AGENTS.md permits a documented scoped aggregate decision. This is not the old 512 MiB backfill policy.
